games.desc:

The warring clans of Japan now fight for their lives. Will you live to see another spring?

games.name: Azure Mines
games.desc:
You're in charge of restoring an old mining facility back to its former glory. 

Use the ore you uncover in the Azure Mines to rebuild your base. In this unique tycoon & mining game hybrid, all of your progress saves and loads automatically. Featuring responsive Xbox controls, this lightweight game ensures a smooth experience regardless of where you're playing it.

Massive randomly-generated caves, tons of detailed hand-designed ore, a unique tycoon element, a robust building system and an integrated level progression sets Azure Mines far apart from previous mining games on Roblox. See for yourself!

games.name: Become Forklift Certified Obby!
games.desc:
Join the Appalling Games group to unlock a FREE Ice Forklift skin!

Operate a forklift to complete the obby. Once you complete all 35 stages, you become forklift certified!
Go to the settings (gear icon) to toggle DPad controls.

Controls:
• WASD - Move your forklift
• Q - Lower fork
• E - Raise fork 
• Double Tap R - Reset character

Admin commands:
• /explode [player]
• /fling [player] [power (optional)]
• /give [player (optional)] [tool] - tools include btools, sword, and rocket/rocketlauncher
• /hint [message]
• /kick [player]
• /kill [player]
• /msg [message]
• /noclip [player (optional)] - Toggles noclip
• /walk [player]
Private server owners and star creators get admin commands!

Premium players get to use the Premium forklift skin!
Note: Real forklifts have turning wheels on the back, but it would've made turning much harder in this game.
